title: Quadratic effective energy--momentum tensor on uniform-density hypersurfaces during slow-roll inflation
summary: We investigate the quadratic-order effective energy--momentum tensor (2EMT) of scalar cosmological perturbations on uniform-density hypersurfaces during slow-roll inflation. The 2EMT is constructed from terms quadratic in the linear metric and inflaton perturbations, and is therefore a gauge-fixed effective source rather than a gauge-invariant observable. We impose the complete scalar gauge conditions $δρ=0$ and $E=0$, express all perturbations in terms of the Bardeen potential $Ψ$, and evaluate the Fourier-space 2EMT in the long- and short-wavelength domains.
